name: Camilla Pareto
source: A student of Arlequint Academy and one of Ernesta's friends. Camilla more serious than her friend and steadfast in her views. She is also very intelligent. Camilla believes that weapons should be made able to use by anyone due to the weapons of the bodyguards not working when her parents were killed.
